items.hook: NATO takes over command of the peacekeeping force in Afghanistan, marking its first major operation outside Europe in its 54-year-history.
items.body: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) is an intergovernmental military alliance between 32 member states. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Captain Francis Light establishes the British colony of Penang in Malaysia.
items.body: Francis Light was a British sailor and explorer best known for founding the colony of Penang and its capital city of George Town in 1786. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: At the 1520 Sedgwick Avenue apartment building in The Bronx, New York, DJ Kool Herc hosts a house party widely considered to mark the birthplace of hip-hop culture and music. DJ Kool Herc demonstrates a new technique of beat juggling and Coke La Rock performs a new style of vocal performance called rapping.
items.body: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue is a 102-unit apartment building in the Morris Heights neighborhood of the Bronx in New York City. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The President's Daughter is a series of four young adult novels written by American author Ellen Emerson White.
items.body: The series tells the story of Meghan “Meg” Powers as she reacts to her mother's presidential campaign and her experiences while living in the White House. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.body: Jemaah Islamiyah was a Southeast Asian Islamist militant group based in Indonesia, which was dedicated to the establishment of an Islamic state in Southeast Asia. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.body: She has published seven novels, and a memoir about her obsession with Judy Garland. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.body: A new play The Singer brings deaf and hearing performers together in a show at this year's Fringe.

items.hook: Francis II assumes the title of first Emperor of Austria.
items.body: Francis II and I was the last Holy Roman Emperor as Francis II from 1792 to 1806, and the first Emperor of Austria as Francis I from 1804 to 1835. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: 1636: The Saxon Uprising is an alternate history novel by Eric Flint in the 1632 series, first published in hardcover by Baen Books on March 29, 2011, with a paperback edition following from the same publisher in March 2012.
items.body: It is a direct continuation of 1635: The Eastern Front. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
